mentions.name: Onigiri
mentions.description: A fully open-source calorie tracker app for iPhone, Apple Watch, and iPad with no subscriptions or ads. It integrates with Apple Health and offers optional AI features, either via on-device Apple Intelligence or bring-your-own keys with Anthropic, OpenAI, and OpenAI-compatible (e.g. self-hosted) services. Planned work includes TestFlight distribution to avoid 7-day signing expiration and improved iCloud integration, with no App Store release planned. Developed with Claude Code and Axiom skills.
mentions.audience: Personal use for weight loss, as the author has used it daily over the past month to lose around 10lbs
